notes: This contract pins the official IEEE 1516.2-2025 DIF schema's class-member uniqueness constraints. The vendored XSD rejects repeated attribute names within one object-class element and repeated parameter names within one interaction-class element before Umbra's identity-based composition runs. Equivalent same-name declarations in separate module documents remain an Annex C composition concern; this contract does not duplicate that schema rule in application code and is private source/test traceability only.
